remarks: A commuter dream! Location, Location Location! One-bedroom condo 1 block away from the Glenbrook train station:The kitchen has newer appliances and opens up to the dining room and living room with brand new carpets with access to the balcony. The super large bedroom has a sliding door to the balcony and has also new carpet. An full bath and new washer and dryer in unit and lots of closet space! All rooms are freshly painted! Unit comes with a reserved parking lot #41 and has several visitor spots and it comes with a private storage area too. A very well maintained building in the best location with easy access to public transportation, parks, beaches, restaurants, shopping, Chelsea Piers, and vibrant Downtown Stamford, NYC and I-95. 2 months security, NO pets, NO smoking, good credit and references required.
